# OmniExecutor Agent

> Autonomous software engineering harness with a durable SQLite-WAL execution engine, executable verification oracle (`--verify`), pipe-aware fail-closed command gating, hierarchical multi-wave team orchestrator (`solo_specialist` -> `dev_squad` -> `executive_enterprise_fleet`), self-healing CDP browser engine, closed-loop Windows desktop RPA, AST-sealed adaptive Python skills, and native MCP / A2A v0.3 / AG-UI protocol support.

## Canonical Documentation
- [README.md](README.md): Complete user & developer guide covering installation, 21 CLI subcommands, 32 workspace tools, 220 deterministic zero-token rails, 10 engineering personas, MCP/ACP/A2A/AG-UI integrations, 15 SAST rules, playbooks, benchmarks, and caveats.
- [docs/ENGINEERING_AND_MATH_MANUAL.md](docs/ENGINEERING_AND_MATH_MANUAL.md): Exact mathematical formulations (durable effect fencing, Brier autonomy tiers, PageRank code centrality, RAM worker scaling, Casimir storage pressure, UCB1 evolution, pipe-aware command classification, and two-stage tool probability selection).
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Setup, automated verification gate, constitutional seal boundaries, and extension points.
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): Defense-in-depth security architecture, secret/SAST rules, symlink protection, and reporting policy.
- [LICENSE](LICENSE): MIT License.

## Entry Points
- Public Python Facade: `from am_ua import OmniExecutorAgent` (`src/am_ua/__init__.py` -> `src/am_ua/agent_kernel.py`)
- Windows CLI Wrapper: `omni-executor.cmd` (`src/am_ua/cli.py`)
- MCP Server (`stdio`, JSON-RPC 2.0): `omni-executor.cmd mcp-serve` (`src/am_ua/execution/mcp_federation.py`)
- ACP Server (`stdio`, JSON-RPC 2.0): `omni-executor.cmd acp-serve` (`src/am_ua/execution/acp_adapter.py`)
- A2A v0.3 & Channel Gateway: `SubAgentSessionBus.handle_a2a_rpc` / `ingest_channel_event` (`src/am_ua/execution/subagent_bus.py`)
- Live AG-UI SSE Stream: `--agui-port <port>` (`src/am_ua/cognition/agui_protocol.py`)

## CLI Subcommands (21)
- `det list|run`: Programmable 220-rail zero-token deterministic execution hub (AST, clones, SBFL, TLA+, Raft, live silicon CPU probe, BM25, SQL, JWT/Merkle).
- `swebench validate-predictions`: Validate SWE-bench prediction JSONL/artifacts deterministically.
- `fleet`: Run v5.4+ HyperFleet high-density concurrent multi-agent coordinator.
- `lsp`: Persistent LSP diagnostics and go-to-definition engine with AST fallback.
- `daemon`: Always-on SQLite WAL background task and webhook queue.
- `doctor`: Multi-organ readiness, SQLite-WAL single state owner, SHA-256 constitutional seal, and host headroom.
- `shield [target]`: Static security & SAST scanner (`Grade A`–`F` across 15 rules).
- `mission "<objective>"`: Autonomous coding/browser/desktop execution verified against `--verify` (`--workflow react|sparc|hierarchical`, `--role`, `--best-of-n`, `--wheel-timeout`, `--agui-port`).
- `repomap [target]`: Polyglot AST symbol map ranked with PageRank (`Python`, `JS/TS`, `Rust`, `Go`).
- `radar [target]`: Topological coupling & cohesion summary.
- `browser observe|act|extract`: Isolated Playwright/CDP browser with `[1..N]` indexed DOM, self-healing selectors, and payment hard-stop guard.
- `pc probe|windows|observe|find|clipboard|processes|port`: Closed-loop Windows UIA + Set-of-Mark + OCR automation.
- `skills list|search|run`: AST-gated, SHA-256 sealed adaptive Python skills & CLI wrappers.
- `mcp-serve`: Expose 7 tools over MCP `stdio`.
- `acp-serve`: Expose interactive agent sessions over ACP `stdio` (`initialize`, `session/new`, `session/prompt`, `session/cancel`).
- `bench run|report`: Execute or summarize sealed evaluation tasks (`eval/am_bench/`).
- `wheel status|resume|abort`: Human-in-the-loop pause/resume control.
- `ingest-doc <file>`: Ingest `.docx`/`.xlsx`/`.csv`/`.pdf`/`.md` with external taint tracking.
- `handoff`: Export portable `HANDOFF_PACK`.
- `pipeline "<objective>"`: Deterministic diagnostic pipeline.

## Key Subsystems (`src/am_ua/`)
- `governance/seal_guard.py`: SHA-256 manifest enforcement over protected zones (`constitution/`, `eval/`).
- `governance/homeostasis.py`: RAM, disk pressure (`F_c(d)`), token budget, and stagnation governor.
- `execution/durable_engine.py`: SQLite-WAL durable state owner, effect taxonomy, `OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` recovery, lease-epoch fencing, and time-travel `fork_run_from_step()`.
- `execution/hook_engine.py`: Deterministic `PreToolUse`/`PostToolUse` hooks, `ToolOutputGuardrail` + `ToolGuardrailTripwireError` + `post_output_secret_redactor`, secret write blocker, `pre_write_test_tamper_guard`, Python AST checker, pipe-aware 5-class command classifier (`READ | WRITE | NETWORK | INSTALL | DESTRUCTIVE`), structural `PolicyRails` (`fetch-to-exec`, `raw-disk-op`, `catastrophic-delete`), opaque subshell escalation (`UNKNOWN`), and worst-case `evaluate_ensemble_risk`.
- `execution/agent_loop.py`: ReAct/SPARC/Hierarchical loop, Turn-0 workspace inventory + `WorkspaceMarkerTrigger` toolchain hints, multi-hunk transactional `replace_in_file`, `task_tracker` (`view`/`plan`), `spill_query`, restricted AST `code_sandbox`, SSRF-guarded `web_fetch`, typed `output_schema` (`ModelRetry`), runtime `handoff_agent`, half-window tombstone condensation, `DeterministicPreCritic`, up to 6 batched actions/turn, symlink escape guard, `ROLE_TOOL_SCOPES`, and `rank_tools_for_objective` (`FamilyThenDecide` / `RetrieveThenDecide`).
- `cognition/reasoning_bank.py`: Hybrid Jaccard + SONA trajectory replay with `sleeptime_consolidate()` and `consult_tom()` background user-model synthesis.
- `execution/subagent_bus.py`: 3-tier severity-scored team orchestration (`1 -> 4 -> 9` agents across 4 waves, max depth `2`, max `16` agents, exclusive GUI lock), `ROLE_PROVIDER_PROFILES`, dependency-aware `execute_dag()`, A2A v0.3 JSON-RPC, and inbound channel burst debouncing.
- `gui/cdp_browser.py`: Indexed CDP browser with `allowed_domains`/`prohibited_domains`/`block_ip_addresses` domain guard, self-healing DOM recovery, and checkout/payment boundary hard stop.
- `memory/triad_provider.py`: Unified core blocks + bi-temporal + Q-utility memory with host-pinned `ScopedMemoryFacade` namespace isolation.
- `perception/`: `polyglot_repomap.py` (PageRank), `knowledge_index.py` (SHA-256 incremental tree index & Mermaid export), `silicon_radar.py`.
- `security/agent_shield.py`: 15-rule scanner covering hardcoded keys, MCP configs, hook injection, permission bypasses, Python/JS/TS SAST patterns, and `prove_policy_containment()` formal policy prover.
